message.content: 洛杉磯（太平洋標準時間，UTC‑8）與柏林（中歐標準時間，UTC+1）之間的時差為 **9 小時**。也就是說，當洛杉磯是正午12點時，柏林已經是晚上9點。

But likely they want the current time difference. We can compute based on standard offsets: Los Angeles is Pacific Time (UTC-8 normally, UTC-7 during DST). Berlin is Central European Time (UTC+1 normally, UTC+2 during DST). So difference is typically 9 hours (Berlin ahead) or 10 hours depending on DST. Let's check current date: It's 2026-11-03. In November, DST in US ends early November; in Europe DST ends last Sunday of October. So as of 2026-11-03, both are on standard time: Los Angeles is PST (UTC-8), Berlin is CET (UTC+1). So difference is 9 hours. So Berlin is 9 hours ahead of Los Angeles. Provide answer accordingly. No function call needed.
